sourceKind: Four complete raw tmux capture-pane -p -N -T post-failure snapshots, preserved row positions and lengths. Rows10/38 cwd and row15 challenge use equal-length synthetic replacements; capture3 row18 response is synthetic with length preserved. Raw final LF preserved. Cursor36/2, process/pane IDs and modes reconstructed, not recorded in these text files. Ready/draft/guard pre-Enter frames are explicit reconstructions from capture0: row15 blanked, row33 cleared, row38 idle status; draft row36 and warning-only footer reconstructed. No actual ready/pending/guard sequence in this fixture. These delayed captures do not prove bounded-window live acceptance.
prompt: Reverse 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef. Reply ACK:<reversed nonce> only. No tools.
